description: Best-effort scan of supplied text for common patterns: email, phone, US SSN, Luhn-checked card numbers, mod-97 IBANs, IP addresses, private-key shapes, BIP-39 seed phrases and API-key shapes. POST JSON {text, redact?}. Returns findings with type and offsets; redacted text only when redact is true. Best-effort only, not a compliance assessment. Informational only, no warranty. This service does not log or store the text you submit. USDC on Base only. Bad input is not charged. Price $0.02 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Paid calls are subject to Horizon Pulse buyer terms: https://horizonpulse.dev/terms/buyer
